message.content:
This black-and-white editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The word "TEMPO" appears in large red capital letters at the top. Beneath it, smaller red text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below that are two headlines: "Kekerasan di Pesantren Gontor H.70" and "Skenario Perubahan Dana Pensiun PNS H.80". A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner, above the date "19-25 SEPTEMBER 2022".

The central image shows four caricatured people and a red car. Inside the car, a woman with short dark hair and glasses sits in the driver's seat, holding a steering wheel. She has a stern expression, pointing her right index finger upward. Next to her in the passenger seat, another woman with long dark hair is smiling broadly. Behind them, a man in a white collared shirt sits in the back seat, looking toward the viewer with a hand on his forehead, appearing stressed. Outside the car, to the right, a fourth person—a man in a white shirt and black trousers—stands with his hands on his hips, looking towards the car with a smirk.

The background shows a simple, hazy landscape with a horizon line. The foreground is the red hood of the car. At the bottom, white capital letters state: "GANJAR HILANG, PUAN TERBILANG". Smaller text below it reads: "Peluang Ganjar Pranowo menjadi calon presiden pada 2024 lewat PDI Perjuangan nyaris tertutup. Bagaimana manuver Puan Maharani meraih restu Megawati? H.28".
